tools.name: instance.capabilities
tools.description: Read this instance contract capabilities, profile metadata, engine residency state, and dependency readiness.

tools.name: workflow.validate
tools.description: Validate an inline workflow snapshot, node allowlist, Artifact input bindings, and locked model dependencies.

tools.name: task.submit
tools.description: Admit an immutable inline workflow snapshot on this interactive instance with automatic Artifact input materialization and output collection. When executed as a publish smoke run, pass session_id and expected_draft_version so the server atomically binds and verifies the session draft against snapshot.prompt.

tools.name: task.get
tools.description: Read authorized task status, GPU lease summary, resolved seeds, and archived Artifact output refs.

tools.name: task.cancel
tools.description: Request targeted cancellation of a single authorized task without disrupting unrelated queue items.

tools.name: session.open
tools.description: Open a fixed-revision read or exclusive editing lease. Replays do not renew it.

tools.name: session.renew
tools.description: Renew this live lease after rechecking current project access.

tools.name: session.close
tools.description: Close a lease while retaining local drafts and tasks.

tools.name: workflow.get
tools.description: Read the current local draft. This is not a Project commit.

tools.name: workflow.update
tools.description: Replace the local draft with optimistic version checking and an exclusive edit lease.

tools.name: diag.runtime_spec
tools.description: Read sanitized effective worker runtime specification, mounts, custom node lock digest, and GPU residency state (safe equivalent to kubectl get/describe).

tools.name: diag.logs
tools.description: Read sanitized, project/task-scoped ring-buffer log lines from comfyui-supervisor and engine subprocess with boot_id cursor fencing. Lines tagged with any other project_id != req.project_id are unconditionally excluded for all callers; untagged instance lifecycle lines (project_id == null) are appended only when the caller holds instance owner or organization admin permission (indicated via response scope_included). First un-cursored tail read omits since_seq; incremental reads passing since_seq MUST also pass boot_id.

since_seq.description: Exclusive sequence cursor; when specified, boot_id is mandatory.

tools.name: diag.execution_trace
tools.description: Read structured per-node execution timings, failed node input contract, and sanitized Python traceback for a specific task.

tools.name: diag.object_info
tools.description: Query paginated and filtered ComfyUI node input/output definitions cached by the instance supervisor.

tools.name: repair.reload_models
tools.description: Refresh the worker read-only model directory index (/models:ro) after a new model reaches ready state without interrupting editing leases.

tools.name: repair.free_vram
tools.description: Trigger two-step soft VRAM unload on an S2 Idle-Evictable instance (zero active/dispatching/collecting/reconciling tasks and human_protected=false) while preserving boot_id and drafts.

tools.name: repair.restart_worker
tools.description: Perform controlled single-instance Runtime stop-barrier and generation+1 rotation after full NVML + cgroup zero-PID reclamation proof while preserving /workspace drafts.

tools.name: model.list
tools.description: List standard catalog models and Station local model cache inventory across 8 categories and 7 lifecycle states (6 provisioning states + evicting).

tools.name: model.status
tools.description: Read real-byte 7-state lifecycle progress (not_installed/queued/downloading/verifying_sha256/ready/failed/evicting), SHA-256 verification status, and relative /models:ro view name without host path leakage.

tools.name: model.ensure
tools.description: Trigger Station singleflight CAS download and .safetensors header + SHA-256 verification into /data/models/comfyui/ under open-source, paid_access == false, and quota gates. Passing expected_sha256 that differs from the catalog entry fails synchronously with 409 MODEL_CATALOG_SHA256_MISMATCH before queuing any download.

tools.name: api.extract_spec
tools.description: Extract a candidate WorkflowAPISpec v1 parameter schema, model_dependencies lock, and VRAM estimate from the current session draft.

tools.name: api.publish
tools.description: Freeze a session draft, smoke-verified DAG template, and WorkflowAPISpec v1 into an immutable versioned API endpoint with server-derived VRAM budget and model pins.

mount_channel.description: none requires project publish permission; image or video projects the endpoint into organization-wide Media MCP catalog, MUST equal spec.output_modality, and requires Organization Admin / Station Admin authorization.

exposed_inputs.description: Structural and conditional type envelope; server publish compiler additionally enforces strict Python int AST tokens (rejecting 1.0), minimum <= maximum, min_length <= max_length, default_value within bounds/enum_values, unique name/(node_id,input_key), and protected slot bans.

max_pixels.description: Mandatory upper pixel envelope (width * height) for artifact_image, artifact_mask, and artifact_video inputs so input media resolution cannot bypass server-derived VRAM budgets.

max_frames.description: Mandatory upper frame count envelope for artifact_video inputs.

seed_policy.description: Server CSPRNG generates random seeds strictly within IEEE-754 safe non-negative integers 0..9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1); caller-supplied seeds, fixed template seeds, and default_value seeds MUST be exact JSON integer tokens within 0..9007199254740991 and are rejected with 400 INVALID_PARAMETERS if out of range (never truncated, modulo-wrapped, or saturation-clamped).

model_dependencies.description: Closed 9-field dependency declarations; both task.submit (smoke) and api.publish canonicalize each (model_id, sha256) via Station Model Catalog into canonical_model_lock_v1 sorted JSON before computing model_dependencies_sha256.

tools.name: api.list
tools.description: List immutable published workflow API endpoints available to this organization and project.

tools.name: api.describe
tools.description: Read the full parameter contract, seed policy, server-computed VRAM budget, and dependency readiness of a published workflow API version (omitting version deterministically selects the highest SemVer and echoes resolved_version).

tools.name: api.invoke
tools.description: Invoke an immutable published workflow API endpoint on the headless API Worker pool with strict parameter injection and automatic Artifact output archiving.

params.description: Strict parameter map validated against WorkflowAPISpec.exposed_inputs; integer values must be exact JSON integer tokens within -9007199254740991..9007199254740991 (seed slots 0..9007199254740991).
